title: GEOPM Power Balancer：固定功率預算與慢節點
titleEn: GEOPM power balancing: fixed budgets and straggler nodes
subcategoryTitle: 能源工程與彈性工作流
summary: 以合成資料重建「GEOPM Power Balancer：固定功率預算與慢節點」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付cap守恆、節點時間、能量上界與非功率瓶頸反例。
summaryEn: Reconstruct GEOPM power balancing: fixed budgets and straggler nodes with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver cap conservation, node timings, energy bounds and non-power bottleneck counterexamples.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「功率與迭代同步圖」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Power and iteration synchronization: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 慢節點若由I/O或負載量造成，加功率未必改善；cap值不能當真實消耗量積分。
只有結果相同、總cap未超與實測功率／時間支持才接受；本課不操作真實功率控制。
GEOPM Power Balancer以整體功率預算調整節點分配；本課用四節點同步迭代模型分析能量取捨。
optionsEn: A straggler caused by I/O or unequal work may not benefit from more power; caps are not measured energy samples.
Accept only with equal results, budget compliance and measured power/timing support; no real power controls are operated here.
GEOPM Power Balancer adjusts node allocations under an application-wide budget; a four-node synchronized model examines energy tradeoffs.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。GEOPM Power Balancer以整體功率預算調整節點分配；本課用四節點同步迭代模型分析能量取捨。 與本階段判準一起判讀：總時間取最慢者；只有cap涵蓋整個建模功率範圍且對完整區間成立才可當上界，局部限制不足。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. GEOPM Power Balancer adjusts node allocations under an application-wide budget; a four-node synchronized model examines energy tradeoffs. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: The slowest node sets time; caps support the bound only when they cover the entire modeled power domain over the full interval. Partial-domain limits are insufficient.

steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. The slowest node sets time; caps support the bound only when they cover the entire modeled power domain over the full interval. Partial-domain limits are insufficient.

steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 總時間取最慢者；只有cap涵蓋整個建模功率範圍且對完整區間成立才可當上界，局部限制不足。
steps.checkEn: The slowest node sets time; caps support the bound only when they cover the entire modeled power domain over the full interval. Partial-domain limits are insufficient.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: GEOPM Power Balancer以整體功率預算調整節點分配；本課用四節點同步迭代模型分析能量取捨。
knowledge.textEn: GEOPM Power Balancer adjusts node allocations under an application-wide budget; a four-node synchronized model examines energy tradeoffs.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 以合成資料重建「GEOPM Power Balancer：固定功率預算與慢節點」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付cap守恆、節點時間、能量上界與非功率瓶頸反例。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct GEOPM power balancing: fixed budgets and straggler nodes with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver cap conservation, node timings, energy bounds and non-power bottleneck counterexamples.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 同步迭代時間=max(node_times)。只有各cap確實限制同一完整迭代區間內、整個建模節點範圍的平均功率時，sum(power_caps)×iteration_time才是能量上界；局部package/RAPL限制不自動涵蓋整機，也不是設施實測能量。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronized iteration time=max(node_times). The bound sum(power_caps)×iteration_time requires each cap to bound the mean power of its entire modeled node domain over the same full interval. A package/RAPL cap is not automatically a whole-node bound, and this is not measured facility energy.

stages.title: 功率與迭代同步圖
stages.description: 畫四節點時間條及同步邊界，區分每節點cap與實際power空欄；標出cap覆蓋的功率範圍與有效時間窗。
stages.descriptionEn: Draw four node timelines and synchronization boundaries, separating cap values from unknown actual power; mark each cap power domain and valid time window.
